options.description: Whether a slot with an `ifabsent` may be left out, for data that a program fills the defaults in, such as options. Without it, such a slot is as required as the schema says, as in the JSON Schema generator.

options.name: pruning_mode
options.description: The classes and enums in the output. A designated union always comes with its members.

options.name: tree_root
options.description: The class to use as the tree root, instead of the class with `tree_root: true` in the schema. Only for the `tree_root` pruning mode.

attributes.name: annotations
attributes.description: Whether to keep annotations that no metaslot uses, as LinkML `annotations`.

attributes.name: datatypes
attributes.description: LinkML types for datatype IRIs, on top of the built-in XSD and RDF ones.

attributes.name: default_prefix
attributes.description: Prefix of the namespace most of the ontology's terms are in. Detected if not set.

attributes.name: enums_from_individuals
attributes.description: Whether a class that is just a set of named individuals, and is the range of some property, becomes an enum. A class defined with `owl:oneOf` always does.

attributes.name: imports
attributes.description: LinkML schemas to import instead of `owl:imports`, keyed by ontology IRI. Other `owl:imports` are left out with a warning.

attributes.name: metadata
attributes.description: Annotation properties to read each metaslot from, in order of preference. Replaces the default list only for the metaslots it lists.

attributes.name: multivalued
attributes.description: Whether slots are multivalued unless the property is functional. On by default, because OWL allows any number of values.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The schema `name`. Defaults to the ontology's `rdfs:label` if it is a valid name, else the default prefix.

attributes.name: naming
attributes.description: How names are made from IRIs.

attributes.name: prefixes
attributes.description: Extra prefixes, on top of the ones the ontology declares.

attributes.name: renames
attributes.description: Fixed names for specific terms, keyed by IRI or CURIE.

attributes.name: schema_id
attributes.description: The schema `id`. Defaults to the ontology IRI.

attributes.name: some_values_from
attributes.description: How to read `owl:someValuesFrom`.

DatatypeMapping.description: The LinkML type for a datatype IRI.

ImportMapping.description: The LinkML schema to import instead of an ontology.

attributes.name: ontology
attributes.description: The IRI of the imported ontology.

attributes.name: schema
attributes.description: Path to the LinkML schema, relative to where the new schema is written.

MetadataSources.description: The annotation properties a metaslot is read from, in order of preference.

Naming.description: How names are made from the local part of IRIs.

attributes.name: classes
attributes.description: Style of class and enum names.

attributes.name: permissible_values
attributes.description: Style of permissible value names made from individuals.

attributes.name: slots
attributes.description: Style of slot names.

NamespacePrefix.description: A prefix and the namespace it stands for.

TermRename.description: A fixed name for a term.

attributes.name: term
attributes.description: The term's IRI or CURIE.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The content of the file.

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: The path of the file.

JsonOutputFormat.description: A serialization for output that can be YAML or JSON.

values.name: yaml
values.description: YAML.

values.name: json
values.description: JSON.

NameStyle.description: How a name is made from the local part of an IRI. In every style, characters that are not allowed in names become underscores.

values.name: keep
values.description: As it is.

values.name: snake
values.description: `has_value`

values.name: pascal
values.description: `HasValue`

values.name: upper_snake
values.description: `HAS_VALUE`

OwlMetadataProfile.description: The annotation property for descriptions in OWL.

values.name: rdfs
values.description: `rdfs:comment`, shown by most OWL tools.

values.name: linkml
values.description: `skos:definition`, as in the LinkML metamodel and `gen-owl`.

OwlPermissibleValueKind.description: The kind of OWL entity for the permissible values of an enum.

values.name: individual
values.description: Named individuals of the enum's class.

values.name: class
values.description: Subclasses of the enum's class, as in `gen-owl`.

PruningMode.description: The elements of the schema to include in the output.

values.name: tree_root
values.description: The elements reachable from the tree root class. Without a tree root, the same as `schema`.

values.name: schema
values.description: Everything defined in the root schema, and every element reachable from it. This leaves out the unused parts of imported schemas, such as most of `linkml:types`.

values.name: skip
values.description: Every element of the root schema and of all its imports.

values.name: ttl
values.description: Turtle, with prefixes and pretty-printed.

values.name: nt
values.description: N-Triples, one statement per line.

ScalaErrorHandling.description: How the generated Scala methods report the `errors` of a function.

values.name: annotation
values.description: Each error class gets an exception class, and the method is annotated with `@throws` for each of them.

values.name: either
values.description: The method returns `Either[E1 | E2, R]`, with the error classes themselves on the left. No exception classes are generated. A function with no `errors` returns `R` as it is.

SomeValuesFrom.description: How to import `C rdfs:subClassOf [ owl:someValuesFrom F ; owl:onProperty p ]`.

values.name: required
values.description: Sets `required: true` on `p` in `C`. If `F` is narrower than the range of `p`, also adds `has_member: {range: F}`, which matches the axiom exactly.

values.name: range
values.description: Sets `required: true` and `range: F`. This is stricter than the axiom, since every value must be an `F`, not just one.

TypeScriptErrorHandling.description: How the generated TypeScript methods report the `errors` of a function.

values.name: exception
values.description: The method returns the value, and its doc comment gets a `@throws` tag for each error class.

values.name: result
values.description: The method returns `Result<R, Failure<...> | ...>`: the value or one of the errors. A function with no `errors` returns `R` as it is.
